patch_description: This redesign uses a compact bitset graph state rather than repeated matrix-cube computations. It builds several C4-free, input-derived retained subgraphs from differently ordered source edges, then performs balanced safe saturation using the common-neighbor characterization directly. A bounded elite ruin-and-refill phase removes high-pressure edges, temporarily bans them during refill, and keeps the best valid candidates. Every construction, refill, and final result is explicitly verified with the pairwise common-neighbor invariant.
